title: デビュー戦の後に・ぐるぐるばったん

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto successfully finishes her debut—but pushes herself to the limit doing so, collapsing shortly after.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A shocking truth is revealed at the infirmary. Meisho Doto has yet to enter her race-ready state.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The race-ready state is an Umamusume's period of growth, so it's understandable that prematurely exerting herself would have this effect.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite the revelation, Meisho Doto can't find it in her heart to give up. Slowly but surely, we'll build up her racing experience.
